With the innings in danger of falling apart, Harpreet Singh Bhatia took responsibility and anchored the recovery.

stories.title: Hasina to return to Bangladesh on December 16, says Awami League
stories.summary: Bangladesh’s exiled former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina wants to return to Dhaka on December 16 and has requested the Bangladesh government to send a Biman Bangladesh aircraft to Delhi for her journey home, sources in the Awami League told The Hindu . The sources said that on Ms.

stories.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi rewrites List A record books with 52-ball double ton as India A cruise into Asia Cup Rising Stars semis
stories.summary: India A will take on Sri Lanka A in the first semifinal of the Asia Cup Rising Stars to be held on Thursday at the West End Park International Stadium in Doha. The fixture was confirmed after Pakistan A’s 96-run win over Nepal in the Group B contest that resulted in former finishing at the top of the table, above India A.

stories.title: India U19 Asia Cup Heroes Aaryavir Sehwag, Mohit Ulva Enter IPL 2027 Auction
stories.summary: India Under-19 Asia Cup-winning stars Aaryavir Sehwag and Mohit Ulva have registered for the IPL 2027 auction after their impressive performances in the tournament, as per reports from Cricbuzz . Both youngsters were part of India's title-winning campaign in Oman, where the team defeated Pakistan by one wicket in a thrilling final.

stories.title: 'I do feel pressure': Vaibhav Sooryavanshi opens up after record-breaking 204
stories.summary: Sooryavanshi registered the fastest century and double century in List A cricket, reaching the 100-run milestone in just 28 balls before completing his double hundred off 52 deliveries. Speaking after being named Player of the Match, Sooryavanshi explained that his approach was initially to spend time at the crease after failing to convert his starts in the previous two matches.

stories.title: World chess championship: Gritty Gukesh weathers time pressure, holds Sindarov
stories.summary: There was this man-against-machine match in chess in 1998. If you thought the machine might have won, you are wrong. The man, named Viswanathan Anand, beat Fritz. The computer had white pieces and it opted for the Spanish Game. Anand, who hadn’t yet won any of his World titles yet, played the Berlin Defence.

stories.title: Russia accuses NATO member Estonia of hostile actions ‘on the verge of unleashing open war’
stories.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry has lashed out at Estonia's government, accusing the NATO member of carrying out a range of "hostile actions" and putting the Baltic state "on the verge of unleashing open war" with Moscow. The outburst underscores rising tensions between Russia and countries on NATO's eastern flank and comes after Estonia announced it will close its road border crossings with Russia from Dec.

stories.title: AFC Champions League Two: East Bengal takes on Al-Hussein in a must-win tie
stories.summary: East Bengal FC faces a decisive test in its continental campaign as it hosts Jordan’s Al-Hussein SC at the Salt Lake Stadium in a Group D clash of the AFC Champions League Two on Tuesday. With qualification for the round of 16 hanging in the balance, the red and gold brigade approaches the penultimate round of the group stage knowing that a victory is essential to keep its hopes alive.

stories.title: ICC has no plans to review saliva ban despite calls from Shubman Gill
stories.summary: The International Cricket Council doesn't plan to review its ban on applying saliva to the ball due to health and cricketing reasons despite calls from Indian captain Shubman Gill .

stories.title: ICC and India, Pakistan Boards must step in: Harbhajan on player behaviour
stories.summary: Harbhajan Singh has urged the International Cricket Council and the respective cricket Boards to rein in player behaviour after recent skirmishes between India and Pakistan at the under-19 and A levels. Reacting to the exchanges during India-A’s defeat to Pakistan-A in the Asia Cup Rising Stars in Doha on Sunday and under-19 Asia Cup final, Harbhajan felt that it set a bad example for youngsters.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi, 15, breaks sixes record by scoring 204 off 53 balls
stories.summary: India's 15-year-old batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the most sixes ever recorded in a senior men's innings in blazing 204 from 53 balls for India A against the United Arab Emirates. While almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket, Sooryavanshi hit 28 sixes and seven fours in the Asia Cup Rising Stars competition - easily breaking Chad Bowes' previous record of 103 balls from 2024 .

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Priyansh Arya breaks record, marks highest individual T20 score by an Indian
stories.summary: Delhi skipper Priyansh Arya rated his scintillating 68-ball 181 (7x4, 19x6) against Tamil Nadu in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) as the best innings of his career. Arya rewrote the record books, registering the highest individual T20 score by an Indian and equalling the record for the most sixes in a T20 innings, alongside Finn Allen.

stories.title: Women’s Asian Champions Trophy 2026: Deepika’s Stunning Hat-Trick Powers India To 6-2 Victory Over China In Bhopal, Extends Unbeaten Run
stories.summary: FP photo Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): It was Deepika's night, India's delight and Bhopal's hockey festival! A sensational first-quarter hat-trick from Deepika powered the hosts to a commanding 6-2 demolition of China in the Madhya Pradesh Women's Asian Champions Trophy at the International Sports Complex on Tuesday.

stories.title: 'Six maara kya?': Tilak reveals dugout's hilarious reaction to Sooryavanshi's carnage
stories.summary: India A captain Tilak Varma was left short of words after witnessing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's breathtaking 204-run assault against the UAE in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. Sooryavanshi produced one of the most destructive batting performances in List A cricket, smashing 204 off just 53 deliveries, including seven fours and a record-breaking 28 sixes.

stories.title: PWL Season 6 to be held in Delhi from January 3-19
stories.summary: The Pro Wrestling League (PWL) has announced the revised schedule for Season 6, which will now be held from January 3 to 19 at the KD Jadhav stadium here. Held under the aegis of the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI), PWL also announced that the player auction for the upcoming season will take place on November 30 in Mumbai.

stories.title: Priyansh Arya rewrites history, breaks KL Rahul's record for highest T20 score
stories.summary: Delhi captain Priyansh Arya produced a breathtaking batting display on Tuesday, smashing a sensational 181 off just 68 balls against Tamil Nadu in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy to rewrite the T20 record books. The left-handed opener smashed an astonishing 19 sixes and 7 fours to power Delhi to a mammoth 275/5 in their 20 overs at the Daly College Ground in Indore.

stories.title: PT Usha out of IOA president's race, Gagan Narang, Virendra Sachdeva in fray
stories.summary: A relatively new-look Indian Olympic Association (IOA) is on the cards. On Tuesday, the final day of nominations, Olympic shooting medallist Gagan Narang and Archery Association of India secretary general Virendra Sachdeva filed their nominations for the post of IOA president. Former IOA secretary general Rajeev Mehta is also in the fray for the top post, making it a three-way contest.

stories.title: 54th International Emmys: Real Kashmir FC misses out, India returns without a win
stories.summary: The Indian series was up against the UK's A Thousand Blows , France's Careme and Argentina's Menem . It was Careme , an Apple TV production, that took home the award, leaving India without a win this year. While the result didn't go India's way, the nomination meant a lot to the team behind Real Kashmir Football Club .

stories.title: Asia Cup Rising Stars: UAE elects to bat against India ‘A’
stories.summary: United Arab Emirates won the toss and opted to bat against India in their final Group B match of the Asia Cup Rising Stars 50-over tournament here on Tuesday. India A have made three changes to the playing XI, bringing in Prabhsimran Singh, Harsh Dubey and Arshad Khan in place of Ayush Badoni, Vipraj Nigam and Prince Yadav.

stories.summary: In what turned out to be a fairly lopsided finish to a high-stakes clash, Deepika’s first-quarter hat-trick powered defending champions India to a record 6–2 victory over China in the Madhya Pradesh Women’s Asian Champions Trophy here on Tuesday, taking the hosts to the top of the standings and to their highest-ever FIH world ranking of No.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Peerless Priyansh plunders a hapless Tamil Nadu attack
stories.summary: Delhi skipper Priyansh Arya registered the highest individual T20 score by an Indian, hammering a 68-ball 181 (7x4, 19x6) to power Delhi to 275 for five and a 116-run win over Tamil Nadu in Group B of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy at the Daly College ground here on Tuesday.

stories.title: The teacher's son, comeback kid and a teenage champion: India's World Tennis League season 5 squad
stories.summary: Eight players. Eight journeys. One stage. From overcoming career-threatening injuries and leaving home as teenagers to winning Asian Games gold and breaking through on the international circuit, India's contingent at the World Tennis League (WTL) Season 5 brings together stories that go well beyond the tennis court.

stories.title: Amit Shah: Kartarpur corridor to open after review
stories.summary: Union home minister Amit Shah expressed that the Kartarpur Sahib Corridor will only reopen after addressing prevailing security issues. This corridor, which offers hassle-free access for pilgrims, was shut down following security alerts linked to Operation Sindoor. Shah highlighted the need to keep national security discussions free from political influences, while also pointing out that the corridor's placement in Pakistan stemmed from Congress party oversights during partition.

stories.title: What does ₹1.25L monthly budget look like? ‘ ₹30,000 grocery, ₹20,000 grooming’: Noida couple’s expenses go viral
stories.summary: Owning a home does not always mean that monthly expenses are low. 25 lakh every month, even though they own their house and do not have to pay rent. The couple shared a video on Instagram explaining their monthly expenses. Their spending includes groceries, household help, gym memberships , grooming, food and travel.

stories.title: The price of no climate deal: After COP31, what's next for India and the world | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations (UN) climate summit in Antalya, COP31, ran two days over schedule and ended on November 22 without a cover decision, the overarching text that sums up what a summit achieved. As petrostates like Saudi Arabia and Russia pushed to omit fossil fuels from the final draft, the text was reluctantly accepted by many countries.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.title: Explainer-Mexico nabs yet another top drug lord, but history of ‘Kingpin Strategy’ mixed
stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. His capture is the latest in a string of arrests of high-profile suspected drug traffickers as Mexico — under intense pressure from US President Donald Trump — has decisively returned to the so-called Kingpin Strategy.

stories.title: Inside Trump's Secret Mission to Bring Jensen Huang Back To Nvidia | Explained
stories.summary: S. President Donald Trump personally intervened to orchestrate Jensen Huang’s stunning return as chief executive of Nvidia—just 11 days after the tech boss resigned amid an intelligence scandal—according to a CNN report detailing a weekend-long White House pressure campaign. S. economy, and America’s lead in the global AI race, Trump contacted Nvidia’s board directly—even dialing into a board meeting—while assigning Vice President JD Vance to coordinate an intensive 72-hour push with directors.

stories.title: Explainer-What are the disputes between Iraq’s federal government and Kurdistan region?
stories.summary: The orders are part of a broader crackdown by Zaidi against oil smuggling. They also reopen long-running disputes between Baghdad and the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) over control of oil, money, territory and trade. Though Baghdad says state oil marketer SOMO has sole authority to export Iraq’s crude, for years the KRG exported independently through a pipeline to Turkey’s Ceyhan port.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: Civilian defence staff seek 6% annual increment, OPS and 50% DA merger— 13 key demands explained
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Pratiraksha Mazdoor Sangh (BPMS), an all-India federation of civilian defence employees recognised by the Ministry of Defence, has submitted a fresh list of around 73 demands to the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC), seeking substantial improvements in salaries, pensions and service benefits for central government employees, particularly defence civilian personnel.

stories.title: What do lemurs and opera singers share?
stories.summary: Have you seen opera performers sing? You might notice how their mouths move according to how high their pitch needs to be. Imagine finding out a primate in the rainforests of Madagascar has been doing the same, possibly even before opera began? With a pointy snout, large eyes and usually a long tail, you might have encountered this primate in one of your favourite movies, Madagascar.

stories.title: Year-round tax planning for salaried employees: a 12-month approach explained
stories.summary: By Archit GuptaEvery person’s personal finance rests on three things. The first is protecting yourself and your family through life and health insurance. The second is your home, and the loan that usually comes with it. The third is building wealth, turning your savings into a corpus that grows over time, whether that corpus is a retirement fund decades away or simply money set aside for a year-end holiday.

stories.title: Cases against Megaspeed, the Singapore firm tied to Jensen Huang’s brief ouster from Nvidia | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The US on Monday blacklisted Megaspeed International, the Singapore company whose former chief executive's affair with Jensen Huang led to his brief ouster from Nvidia , as an investigation continues into whether it moved the American firm's AI chips into China. Nvidia reinstated Huang the same day the US announced its decision.

stories.title: What lies beyond Wayanad’s misty mountains?
stories.summary: The path narrows between rows of dark-green coffee bushes. The low branches of pepper sag under tight clusters of unripe green cherries. Spiders hang their webs between the plants and along the poles. ,” says one visitor, ducking the hanging web, afraid to break it. Arun George, the owner of GP Ecotic Land, Coffee and Eco Tourism, in Kattikulam, Wayanad explains how a chemical spray would have cleared them away.

stories.title: Who is Sugandha Hiremath? Meet businesswoman at centre of Kalyani family’s ₹1 lakh crore ancestral wealth dispute
stories.summary: Sugandha Hiremath, sister of Bharat Forge chairman Baba Kalyani, is at the centre of a high-profile inheritance dispute involving the Kalyani family’s ancestral wealth , estimated at more than ₹ 1 lakh crore. The legal battle, which has dragged on across judicial forums, involves claims over family assets, properties and stakes in companies linked to the Pune-based industrial family.

stories.title: Taxpayer sold Bitcoin worth ₹4.94 crore and disclosed it in ITR, yet faced a tax notice. Why? HC ruling explained
stories.summary: A taxpayer who disclosed Bitcoin transactions worth nearly ₹ 5 crore in his income tax return still faced reassessment proceedings after the Income Tax Department alleged that he had failed to report the cryptocurrency transactions. The dispute eventually reached the Gujarat High Court, which found that the department's allegation was based on an incorrect reading of the taxpayer's return.

stories.title: Can you play as Jason and Lucia together in GTA 6? Character-switching explained
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 gives players two protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, who share a story and work together as partners. But can players actually take control of both characters at the same time? The answer is yes and no. GTA 6 allows players to bring Jason and Lucia together for activities, missions and robberies, but they cannot directly control both characters simultaneously.

stories.title: Why BJP is keen on renaming West Bengal ‘Paschim Banga’? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 23, 2026, West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the State will be referred to as ‘Paschim Banga’ in all languages including English. Mr. Adhikari said the State Cabinet had passed the proposal and a new resolution to the effect would be tabled in the Assembly on December 9.

stories.title: Who is Harpreet Singh Bhatia? Former India U-19 cricketer who hit a 120-ball 100 for UAE against India A
stories.summary: Harpreet Singh Bhatia, once regarded as one of India’s promising young batting talents, found himself up against his former cricketing countrymen on Tuesday, scoring a 100 off 120 balls, with 11 fours and a six, for the UAE against India A in a must-win Group B encounter at the Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 in Doha.

stories.title: ‘Portfolio rebalancing’: JioStar to lay off around 150 employees this week - what we know
stories.summary: JioStar, the largest media and entertainment company in India, is set to undertake another round of layoffs this week. According to Exchange4media, around 150 employees would be affected by the layoffs, expected this week. The report, citing top sources at JioStar , said that the layoff is expected to span multiple functions, including marketing, production, studios and other operational departments.

stories.title: Why has the Musafirkhana building linked to Dawood Ibrahim been in court for 23 years? | Explained
stories.summary: The controversy revolving around the demolition of Haji Ismail Haji Habib Musafirkhana, a building located on Pakmodia Street in Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar and associated with gangster Dawood Ibrahim, has once again reached the Bombay High Court. Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) cited the ‘dangerously dilapidated’ condition of the building as a reason for demolition.

stories.title: What COP31 collapse means for India – and the future of climate change policy
stories.summary: The European Union, the United Kingdom, Panama and small island states including Tuvalu and the Marshall Islands refused a cover decision that said nothing about moving away from fossil fuels. Earlier in the week, the Arab Group and Russia had rejected drafts for the opposite reason, objecting to any language that named energy sources or set sectoral targets.

stories.title: Are you bigger than CM? Cops snap at UP woman during convoy movement
stories.summary: The clip, circulating on social media, shows the woman requesting permission to cross the road while police personnel manage barricades during Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's convoy movement. The officer was heard telling her, “ Mukhyamantri se badh ke ho tum? )." The woman's repeated pleas and the officer's response have since become the focus of online discussions.

stories.title: WhatsApp Web advisory: What the risks are and why govt recommends logging out of a session | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The National Cybercrime Threat Analytics Unit of the Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C), which is part of the Union home ministry, issued an advisory (TAU/ADV/021) last week on the safe use of WhatsApp Web . It said a logged-in WhatsApp Web session “may, under certain circumstances, be misused” to get into a person’s account.

stories.title: From kala pani to Rikers, history of island prisons and the waters used to lock people in | HT Explainers
stories.summary: In Alexandre Dumas's The Count of Monte Cristo, the young sailor Edmond Dantès works out where the gendarmes are rowing him only as the boat nears the Château d'If, a fortress on a rock off Marseille. He protests that it holds only political prisoners, and asks whether there are any magistrates or judges there.

stories.title: Should India make FMGE qualifiers' names and marks public every year?
stories.summary: The Central Information Commission (CIC) has now brought this question into focus, directing the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) to disclose the names and marks of candidates who cleared the June 2025 FMGE, as per PTI. The commission has also advised the examination body to publish these details every year, bringing greater transparency to a process that determines which foreign-trained doctors can move closer to practising in India.

stories.title: Training vs inference: What’s the distinction at the heart of the Sarvam AI-China models controversy? | Explained
stories.summary: Sarvam AI has so far been known for developing its own Artificial Intelligence (AI) models with support from the government’s IndiaAI Mission. On November 16, the Bengaluru-based startup added another part to its business with the launch of Token Factory, a commercial service that gives businesses access to its own models and those developed by other companies, including Chinese firms.

stories.title: Charlie Puth announces first-ever India concert in Mumbai on February 13; Ellie Goulding to perform
stories.summary: Business Today Desk Updated Nov 24, 2026 4:03 PM IST Charlie Puth, known for global hits including Attention, We Don't Talk Anymore and See You Again, expressed excitement about performing for Indian audiences. Grammy-nominated singer, songwriter and producer Charlie Puth will perform in India for the first time on February 13, 2027, headlining the inaugural Johnnie & Co.

stories.title: Mumbai-Pune take a walk on the wild side
stories.summary: At a time when Mumbai is grappling with rising air pollution, deteriorating AQI levels and the loss of precious green cover to infrastructure and redevelopment projects, nature walks are finding an enthusiastic audience. More Mumbai and Punekars appear keen to step away from their screens and concrete surroundings to explore the city's green pockets, mangroves, biodiversity and lesser-known natural habitats.

stories.title: Charlie Puth, Ellie Goulding to perform at inaugural Johnnie & Co. Festival in Mumbai; check details
stories.summary: Business Today Desk Updated Nov 24, 2026 6:15 PM IST Charlie Puth, known for global hits including Attention, We Don't Talk Anymore and See You Again, expressed excitement about performing for Indian audiences. stories.title: Mumbai Book Festival 2026: A complete guide to unique events this week
stories.summary: Bibliophiles in the suburbs have much to cheer at the inaugural edition of the Mumbai Book Festival 2026. It’s being organised by National Book Trust, Ministry of Education, Government of Maharashtra, BMC, and University of Mumbai and runs from today till November 29 at the sprawling Kalina campus of the University of Mumbai.

stories.title: India's first AI-enabled drug-testing van deployed at Worli Racecourse concert in Mumbai
stories.summary: Amid growing scrutiny of drug consumption at music events, the Anti-Narcotics Cell's (ANC) new AI-enabled forensic van was deployed at a concert at Worli Racecourse on Sunday. The vans are equipped to conduct preliminary drug screening at the scene. The technology can provide an immediate preliminary indication of drug consumption.

stories.title: Mumbai Book Festival 2026: Six-day event to begin at University of Mumbai`s Kalina campus on Tuesday
stories.summary: The six-day Mumbai Book Festival 2026 will kick off at the University of Mumbai's Kalina campus on Tuesday, with Maharashtra Higher and Technical Education Minister Chandrakant Patil urging colleges to ensure maximum student participation in the event. The festival, scheduled to continue until November 29, is being jointly organised by the National Book Trust (NBT), the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) and the University of Mumbai to promote reading habits among young people.

stories.title: From entire towers to entire floors, Mumbai investors drive big-ticket property deals | Real Estate News
stories.summary: An emerging trend in Mumbai’s luxury property market is seeing ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNIs) move beyond buying individual apartments or office units to acquiring entire residential towers and commercial floors. While one buyer may be looking for the privacy and exclusivity of a private mansion, another may see an entire office floor as a long-term investment, a future workplace or a source of rental income.
